verdict.rationale: Jira's official features page lists "SAML & SSO", so the product claims the capability first-party. That claim is a single bare heading with no detail on setup, identity-provider support, enforcement or plan requirements. missing for 10: configuration and identity-provider documentation, SSO enforcement and organization access controls, plan/tier requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can secure organization access with SSO and SAML
